title: Combined Small Treatment Zone Orthokeratology and Alternate-Day 0.01% Atropine for Axial Elongation Control in Rapidly Progressing Myopic Children

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License', no link given; canonical URL below); private

groups.description: small-treatment-zone orthokeratology (worn for at least 6 months before baseline) plus 0.01% atropine eye drops on alternate days from baseline (randomisation); eligibility required axial elongation ≥ 0.20 mm during the initial 6 months of ortho-K wear (pre-enrolment criterion, before the combination began); Qingdao Eye Hospital, China; mean age of the 46 completers (tbl1)

series.notes: mean ± SD; one eye per child (105 children, 105 eyes; which eye is not stated), used as tabulated; baseline = randomisation, after at least 6 months of ortho-K and before atropine started; the 46 children who completed the 12-month follow-up, admitted under inclusion 5: 52 randomised to this group (46 completers + 6 lost to follow-up, Results), 46/52 = 88%

exclusions.reason: selected by a post-treatment outcome: eligibility required axial elongation ≥ 0.20 mm during the first 6 months of the same ortho-K treatment that this group continues ('fast progressors', protocol inclusion 5)
the absolute series (tbl1 baseline, tbl2 AL rows) is used (protocol: Values)

exclusions.what: tbl2 pupil diameter and IOP rows; tbl3 corneal higher-order aberrations; tbl4 pupil-zone defocus; tbl5 regression coefficients
exclusions.reason: not axial length (protocol inclusion 1) or not group values

exclusions.what: AL during the 6 months of ortho-K monotherapy before randomisation (historical records, text only) and the second-6-month interval elongation (text)
exclusions.reason: before the baseline or interval changes; not table cells

notes: Prospective randomized study (Chinese Clinical Trial Registry ChiCTR2300074282), Qingdao Eye Hospital of Shandong First Medical University, August 2023 to June 2025: 105 children aged 8–12 years, SER −0.75 to −5.00 D, cylinder ≤ 1.25 D, who had worn small-treatment-zone ortho-K lenses (back optic zone 5.6 mm) for at least 6 months.
0.01% atropine on alternate days in the early evening; atropine was also used the night before each scheduled visit.
AL by IOLMaster 500 (Carl Zeiss Meditec); units mm (tbl1, tbl2); visits every 3 months after randomisation.
105 enrolled; 5 withdrew from the OK group and 6 of the AOK group were lost to follow-up; 94 completed 12 months (46 AOK, 48 OK).
tbl1 gender counts of the AOK group (15:26) sum to 41, not the 46 of the heading; cited cells are as printed.
